AOV is the governed concept kp:AverageOrderValue (Average Order Value — total sales divided by order count), so I resolve it to its binding sales.sales_performance.average_order_value and filter to calendar year 2023 with `where:` (the window is applied to the binding, not a re-derivation). 2023 is fully inside the dataset's coverage (2015-01-01 .. 2024-04-20), so no anchoring to max_date is needed — it is an absolute year, not a relative window. Running `run: sales_performance -> { where: DT.year = @2023; aggregate: average_order_value }` returns the 2023 average order value; that single figure is the answer.

Basis: kp:AverageOrderValue (governed) | Freshness: 2023-12-31 (full year within coverage to 2024-04-20) | Steward: steward of kp:AverageOrderValue (sales domain, per concept frontmatter)
executed_malloy: run: sales_performance -> { where: DT.year = @2023; aggregate: average_order_value }
